_doc: Rival column sets for fig_ladder. One entry = one panel. To add a set: append an entry with status 'landed', its artefact, a reader, the arm map, pool_rows and its STEP BUDGET (steps_label, asserted by steps_check); add its caption line to the draft. No code change. Readers: 'ladder_csv' (w12 LADDER.csv layout), 'json_path' (value = the JSON leaf at path_template with {n}, {seed}, {arm} substituted) and 'w20_carried' (SHAPES-MATCHED.json ladder.{n}: the P1-carried fit per family and seed, ladder.{n}.P3_margin.<store>.per_family.<fam>.<seed>.carried_rival, value = ladder.{n}.arms.<carried>.all.per_seed[seed]). steps_check readers: 'json_path_each' (every rung x seed x arm leaf at path_template equals steps) and 'w20_convergence' (ladder.{n}.convergence_evidence.<fam>.<seed>.<declared|tenx>.optimizer_steps, per carried fit). Every set is drawn beside the same store and floor. Pool size AND step budget are printed in every panel title: the w20 finding is that the operative variable was steps, not data.
